_about: Ready-made assemblies the app can copy into a house file's assemblies library. Each layer uses a material from materials.json (whose source is cited there) or a framing entry from framing.json. Thicknesses are typical, not measured: measure your own wall where you can. Solid brick thickness: about 4 in per wythe (OS-HPXML uses 4.0 in for brick siding; a fired-clay brick is 3 5/8 in in the CEC Title 24 list, plus mortar); 8 in for two wythes and 12 in for three are nominal.

presets.name: Solid brick, 2 wythes (about 8 in), bare inside
presets.notes: Load-bearing brick two bricks thick, no interior finish (exposed brick).

presets.name: Solid brick, 3 wythes (about 12 in), bare inside
presets.notes: Load-bearing brick three bricks thick, no interior finish.

presets.name: Solid brick, 2 wythes, plaster applied directly
presets.notes: Plaster troweled straight onto the inside of the brick.

presets.name: Solid brick, 2 wythes, plaster on lath over furring
presets.notes: Wood lath and plaster on 1x2 furring strips at 16 in, leaving a 3/4 in air space against the brick.

presets.name: Brick veneer over 2x4 wood frame, empty cavity
presets.notes: One wythe of brick (4 in) with an air gap, over board sheathing on 2x4 studs at 16 in. The stud cavity is empty: change its fill if it is insulated.
